evidence_class_definitions.confirmed_current: Checked-in current or post-freeze evidence supports the scoped statement; this label never upgrades code-only evidence to an empirical performance result.

evidence_class_definitions.negative_current: Current checked-in evidence preserves a scoped negative result.
evidence_class_definitions.exploratory_confounded: The observation is reproducible but a known method-identity or design confound forbids confirmatory interpretation.
evidence_class_definitions.not_evaluated: The requested scientific comparison was not cleanly evaluated.
evidence_class_definitions.external_blocker: The required external data, API, hardware, or independent dataset is unavailable.

qualitative_claim_support.support: The legacy runner records target[k] -> output[k+1]; current types/schema separate state, availability, prediction, executable-target, command, and plant times.
Current interfaces and canonical schema separate estimator, predictor, governor, follower, and plant responsibilities and timing.

Current code implements exact constant-jerk integration, analytic viable-jerk intervals, terminal viability, next-step existence, and a stateful one-step governor. Frozen v3 supports only the historical direct implementation's scoped execution evidence.
qualitative_claim_support.boundary: Derive/formulate/implement are permitted; universal or plant-level guarantee language is not.

qualitative_claim_support.support: Current CommandProfile and RuckigFollower preserve internal segment boundaries and jerks. A regression case contains two segments within one 10 ms prefix, demonstrating why acceleration-difference jerk is not an internal-profile audit.
Current schema and metrics separately record method_semantics, native follower, actual algorithm, shield application, and algorithm-changing fallback.

All direct safety evidence is synthetic/triple-integrator/ideal-plant; no hardware, torque, dynamics, collision, or production evidence exists.
No fresh same-follower v4 P/PV/PVA locked test exists; the v3 primary comparison is mixed/confounded.
